in_arabic.name: عريزة
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يعني الشخصية المعززة أو المكرمة في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عريزة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع ر ز' والذي يعني الرفع أو التكريم. في الإسلام، يعتبر هذا الاسم رمزا للشخصية التي تتمتع بالكرامة و الرفعة. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كرمز للشخصية المعززة.

in_urdu.name: عریزہ
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام اسلامی تعلیمات میں اعزاز یافتہ شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عریزہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع ر ز' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت یا تکریم. یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں کرامت و رفعت والی شخصیت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا خاصا اہمیت ہے.

in_hindi.name: अरीज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में सम्मानित व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरीज़ा नाम अरबी मूल 'ع ر ز' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है गरिमा या सम्मान. इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम सम्मान और गरिमा वाले व्यक्तित्व का प्रतीक है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का विशेष महत्व है.

in_pashto.name: عریزه
in_pashto.meaning: دا نوم د اسلامي دود په معزز شخصیت دلالت کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: عریزه نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع ر ز' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د لوړتوب یا عزت دی. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د عزت او کرامت لرونکي شخصیت نښه ده. د افغان او پښتني دود کې دا نوم ځانګړی اهمیت لري.

in_english.name: Areezah
in_english.meaning: This name signifies a person of dignity and honor in Islam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Areezah is derived from the Arabic root 'ع ر ز' (ʿ-r-z), which means to raise or to honor. In Islamic tradition, Areezah symbolizes a personality that embodies dignity, honor, and respect. The name has historical significance and is used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a noble character.

data.cultural_impact: The name Areezah can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic values of knowledge acquisition and the importance of cultivating a fruitful garden, both metaphorically and in reality. In the Islamic tradition, education and the pursuit of knowledge are highly valued and regarded as a crucial aspect of personal and social development. Additionally, the metaphorical garden refers to one's own life and the importance of nurturing positive relationships, personal growth, and a spiritually fulfilling existence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Areezah symbolizes the duty of each individual to cultivate their inner and outer selves. It encourages the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, as well as the planting of good deeds and actions. Further, it serves as a reminder of Allah's promise in the Quran when He states, "And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth, a bearer of good news and a warner. And there came after you other messengers with the same message. Each community had taken of the messengers a gift, and they studied it. Then there came, following their footsteps, others who distorted the truth. So woe to those to whom the truth came, but they believed not in it, for they will have a grievous punishment." (Quran 36:30). Thus, the name Areezah also reflects the belief that, with the guidance provided by Allah, each individual has the potential to grow and cultivate their inner selves towards a righteous and fulfilling life.
